title: Chess Academy
summary: Interactive chess coach from beginner to expert tactics with a 600-2100 ELO AI o
description: Chess Academy is a complete offline chess teaching program built for the M5Stack Cardputer Zero (320x170 display & 46-key keyboard). Follow a structured 8-chapter, 43-lesson curriculum from piece basics and opening principles through famous opening tactics (Fried Liver Attack, Legal's Mate, Petrov's Trap, Damiano Refutation, Center Fork Trick, Queen's Gambit Trap, Caro-Kann Smothered Mate, Scandinavian Fork), core tactics, combinations, advanced sacrifices, and essential endgames. Features 4 board themes, visual hint arrows, a live evaluation bar, real-time opening book detection & move coaching, 3-star mastery, and a 6-tier PVS/LMR chess engine (600-2100 ELO).
